AboutResponse.description: What this service is and what is running inside it. Read-only, no child data.

components.description: screening_engine, ml_logistic, ml_deep, ml_risk, ml_prediction, growth_monitoring and llm_service, in that order.
components.title: Components

health.description: ok, or degraded when the ML models are missing or mismatched. Same as /health.
health.title: Health

AboutResponse.title: AboutResponse

clinical_assessment.description: Only when a baby under 2500 g has no gestational age: flagged for clinical assessment.

explanation.description: Full Phase 5 Explanation: traces, contributions, margins, audit notes.
explanation.title: Explanation

growth_monitoring.description: Only when previous_measurement was given and the baby is screened on the under-5 route. Advisory: never changes the classification.

ml_prediction.description: Only when the prediction model is switched on (THANZI_PREDICTION_ENABLED=1) and the baby is screened on the plain under-5 route. Advisory, escalate only: never changes the classification.

ml_risk.description: Only when the risk model is switched on (THANZI_RISK_ENABLED=1) and the baby is screened on the plain under-5 route. Advisory, escalate only: never changes the classification.

referral_text.description: Raw Phase 2 referral text. May contain HIV information.
referral_text.title: Referral Text

route.description: Only when birth context was given: under5 or under5_corrected_age.
route.title: Route

age_days_used.description: The age the engine that ran was given.
age_days_used.title: Age Days Used

corrected_age_end_provisional.description: True while the corrected-age end point in use is provisional (GA 32 to under 37 weeks).
corrected_age_end_provisional.title: Corrected Age End Provisional

pma_weeks.description: Post-menstrual age: gestational age plus chronological age.
pma_weeks.title: Pma Weeks

state.description: ok, degraded, off or not_run. For the LLM service see its own /v1/llm/health.
state.title: State

flagged.description: true only for below_range, including weight loss. Advisory.
flagged.title: Flagged

reason.description: Why it was not assessed: interval_too_short, implausible_weight, reference_unverified, outside_reference_ages. null when assessed.
reason.title: Reason

reference_derived.description: true when the weight-gain range used was derived, not published (girls 3 to 6 months).
reference_derived.title: Reference Derived

reference_low.description: g per day, averaged over the age bands the interval covers.
reference_low.title: Reference Low

review_suggested.description: true when the weight-gain result or any trend is flagged. Advisory: a clinician should review the child's growth.
review_suggested.title: Review Suggested

status.description: below_range, within_range or above_range. null when not assessed.
status.title: Status

trends.description: z-score trends across the two visits.

head_circumference_for_age.description: Present only when both visits gave a head circumference.

length_height_for_age.description: Present only when both visits gave a length or height with its position.

status.description: ok, or degraded when the ML models are missing or mismatched.
status.title: Status

ci_low.description: Lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval.
ci_low.title: Ci Low

data_quality_review.description: true when many screened children were UNABLE_TO_CLASSIFY.
data_quality_review.title: Data Quality Review

gam_cases.description: SAM plus MAM. null when counts_suppressed.
gam_cases.title: Gam Cases

status.description: hotspot, watch, not_flagged, insufficient_data or no_data.
status.title: Status

trend.description: rising, falling, steady or not_assessed, against the previous month in the batch.
trend.title: Trend

reference_rate.description: Optional fixed reference rate of SAM+MAM (0 to 1), for example a national survey figure. Default: the rate of all the other districts in the same batch.
reference_rate.title: Reference Rate

rows.description: One row per district and month. The latest month is assessed; earlier months give the trend.
rows.title: Rows

HotspotRow.description: Counts for one district in one month, already grouped by the caller. No child-level data.

district.description: District name only. No facility, community, village or coordinates.
district.title: District

sam.description: Of those, classified SAM (SAM_OTP, SAM_INPATIENT or SAM_ASSESS).
sam.title: Sam

screened.description: Children under five screened in that month.
screened.title: Screened

unable.description: Of those, UNABLE_TO_CLASSIFY. Used for a data-quality flag.
unable.title: Unable

HotspotRow.title: HotspotRow

direction.description: fell, rose or steady. Weight and length are flagged only for a fall; head size for either.
direction.title: Direction

lines_crossed.description: Whole z-score lines (-3 to +3) between the two values.
lines_crossed.title: Lines Crossed

reason.description: Why it was not assessed: interval_too_short, implausible_measurement, outside_reference_ages, oedema_weight_unreliable. null when assessed.
reason.title: Reason

status_change.description: below_minus2 or below_minus3 when newly below that line (weight and length only).
status_change.title: Status Change

calls_measured.description: How many recent /v1/screen calls the figures cover (at most `window`).
calls_measured.title: Calls Measured

p50_ms.description: null until a screening call has been made.
p50_ms.title: P50 Ms

MetricsResponse.description: Counts and durations only. Never a body, a value, an address or anything about a child (D176).

by_route.description: Requests per known route. Anything else is counted under `other`.
by_route.title: By Route

scope.description: process: held in memory, reset on restart, one count per worker process.
scope.title: Scope

since.description: When this process started, Unix seconds.
since.title: Since

MetricsResponse.title: MetricsResponse

available.description: false in degraded mode (models missing or mismatched).
available.title: Available

deep_recording_error.description: Second advisory flag from a small neural network, beside recording_error. Present only when the deep models are loaded. Same meaning, same limits.

PredictionOut.description:
Advisory longitudinal prediction (under-five, 28 to 180 days ahead). It can only add a concern: it never changes the
classification, tier or referral. No concern (`elevated` false, no message) is NOT reassurance, and a child the model
could not score (`scored` false) has no estimate at all.

drivers.description: Up to 3 plain-language findings that raised the estimate. Only when elevated.
drivers.title: Drivers

elevated.description: true: higher than usual chance. false: no extra concern (not reassurance). null: not scored.
elevated.title: Elevated

explanation.description: Exact per-feature contributions. Audit view only.
explanation.title: Explanation

inputs.description: Input groups with an empty input, by reason: not_assessed (not asked), not_applicable (cannot exist for this child), unavailable (given but not usable). Empty inputs never stop a score unless essential for the pathway. null when not checked.
inputs.title: Inputs

non_clinical.description: true for a model trained on simulated outcomes. Never use such a result for care.
non_clinical.title: Non Clinical

not_scored_reason.description: age_outside_model_range, essential_input_unavailable, gap_never_seen_in_training, invalid_input or model_error.
not_scored_reason.title: Not Scored Reason

pathway.description: The input pathway the model was built for, for example anthropometric.
pathway.title: Pathway

provenance.description: simulated or real. Audit view only.
provenance.title: Provenance

scored.description: false when the child could not be scored: see not_scored_reason.
scored.title: Scored

stratum.description: elevated or high. null: no extra concern, or not scored. There is no low-risk label.
stratum.title: Stratum

PredictionOut.title: PredictionOut

growth.description: Change in z-score from birth. Never a diagnosis from one percentile.

ml_features.description: features() row. Context only. rule_level is never a label.
ml_features.title: Ml Features

measurements.description: Fenton 2025 Preterm Growth Chart z-score and percentile per measure, or 'outside_fenton_range'.

tier.description: The under-5 tier this preterm level maps to (docs/modules/preterm.md). Null for follow_up: it has no under-5 tier, use preterm_level.

PreviousMeasurement.description: An earlier visit of the same child, for growth monitoring. The engine stores nothing, so the caller supplies it.

age_days.description: Age in whole days at that earlier visit. Must be before this visit.
age_days.title: Age Days

hc_cm.description: Optional. Head circumference at that visit, cm. With hc_cm on this visit, adds the head-circumference trend.
hc_cm.title: Hc Cm

length_height_cm.description: Optional. Length or height at that visit, cm. With measure_position, adds the length/height-for-age trend.
length_height_cm.title: Length Height Cm

measure_position.description: Required when length_height_cm is given: how that earlier visit was measured.
measure_position.title: Measure Position

weight_kg.description: Weight in kilograms at that earlier visit.
weight_kg.title: Weight Kg

direction.description: Always raises: only findings that raise the estimate are shown.
direction.title: Direction

text.description: Plain-language statement of the finding that raised the estimate.

RiskOut.description:
Advisory clinical risk estimate. It can only add a concern: it never changes the classification, tier or referral,
and the absence of a concern (`elevated` false, no message) must never be shown to a worker as reassurance.

drivers.description: Up to 3 findings that raised the estimate. Only when elevated.
drivers.title: Drivers

elevated.description: true: the model sees a higher than usual chance. false: no extra concern (not reassurance). null: not scored.
elevated.title: Elevated

explanation.description: Exact per-feature contributions. Audit view only.
explanation.title: Explanation

model_kind.description: logistic, gbm_logit or rf_prob. Audit view only.
model_kind.title: Model Kind

non_clinical.description: true for a model trained on simulated outcomes. Never use such a result for care.
non_clinical.title: Non Clinical

not_scored_reason.description: age_outside_model_range, muac_missing, measurement_not_assessable, possible_recording_error, data_quality_check_unavailable, invalid_input or model_error.

provenance.description: simulated or real. Audit view only.
provenance.title: Provenance

scored.description: false when the child could not be scored: see not_scored_reason.
scored.title: Scored

age_days.description: Age in whole days. No date of birth is accepted.
age_days.title: Age Days

apnoea_last_7_days.description: Preterm route: apnoea in the last 7 days.
apnoea_last_7_days.title: Apnoea Last 7 Days

birth_hc_cm.description: Head circumference at birth, cm. Preterm route only; needed for the head-growth trend.
birth_hc_cm.title: Birth Hc Cm

birth_length_cm.description: Length at birth, cm. Preterm route only; needed for the length trend.
birth_length_cm.title: Birth Length Cm

birth_weight_g.description: Birth weight in GRAMS (weight_kg is kilograms).
birth_weight_g.title: Birth Weight G

complications.description: null: not assessed. []: assessed, none present.
complications.title: Complications

consecutive_days_gaining_weight.description: Preterm route: consecutive days of weight gain. If null and failure_to_gain_weight is true, 0 is used.
consecutive_days_gaining_weight.title: Consecutive Days Gaining Weight

danger_signs.description: null: not assessed. []: assessed, none present.
danger_signs.title: Danger Signs

gastric_aspirate_pct.description: Preterm route: gastric aspirate as % of the last tube feed (0 to 100).
gastric_aspirate_pct.title: Gastric Aspirate Pct

gestational_age_weeks.description: Gestational age at birth, decimal weeks (22 to 44). With birth_weight_g it decides routing: born under 37 weeks or under 2500 g goes to the preterm engine until 50 weeks post-menstrual age, then to the under-5 engine on corrected age.
gestational_age_weeks.title: Gestational Age Weeks

hc_cm.description: Head circumference, cm. Preterm route. On the under-5 route it is used only for the head-circumference trend, when previous_measurement.hc_cm is also given.
hc_cm.title: Hc Cm

hiv_positive.description: Optional and sensitive. Never echoed in worker responses.
hiv_positive.title: Hiv Positive

hypoglycaemia_not_correcting.description: Preterm route: hypoglycaemia is not correcting with treatment (the urgent trigger). The complications value hypoglycaemia is itself an urgent trigger on the preterm route (Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) Guidelines, Malawi, 2016, Table 5: inpatient).
hypoglycaemia_not_correcting.title: Hypoglycaemia Not Correcting

length_height_cm.description: Required for the under-5 flow. Optional only when the baby is screened by the preterm engine (born under 37 weeks or under 2500 g, under 50 weeks post-menstrual age); the length z-score is skipped without it.
length_height_cm.title: Length Height Cm

measure_position.description: Required whenever length_height_cm is given. Must be length on the preterm route.
measure_position.title: Measure Position

neonatal_danger_signs.description: Preterm route: signs the danger-sign list of the Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) Guidelines, Malawi, 2016 does not have. null: not assessed. []: assessed, none present. Convulsions, lethargy, hypoglycaemia, severe dehydration and unable to feed are read from danger_signs, complications and too_weak_to_suckle, not asked twice.
neonatal_danger_signs.title: Neonatal Danger Signs

oedema.description: Required: it is never assumed to be absent.
oedema.title: Oedema

previous_measurement.description: Optional earlier visit (age_days, weight_kg). With it the response adds growth_monitoring: weight gain per day compared with the reference range in the ASPEN Paediatric and Neonatal Nutrition Support Handbook, Third Edition, 2024, and z-score trends for weight, length or height, and head circumference (WHO Child Growth Standards, 2006). Advisory only. Under-5 route only.

sick.description: Preterm route: clinician judges the baby sick (hospitalise).
sick.title: Sick

deep_model_version.description: null when the deep models are not loaded.
deep_model_version.title: Deep Model Version

prediction_model_version.description: null when the prediction model is off or not loaded.

risk_model_version.description: null when the risk model is off or not loaded.

programme.description: null for every MAM child: the programme is shown in the audit view only.

rules_fired.description: Display codes. MAM.HIV_OTP and MAM.SFP both show as MAM.REFER.
rules_fired.title: Rules Fired

info.description: Decision support for under-five malnutrition screening (Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) Guidelines, Malawi, 2016). Not a diagnosis. Babies born under 37 weeks or under 2500 g are routed to the preterm engine (Fenton 2025, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) until 50 weeks post-menstrual age, then screened on corrected age. Demonstration only: synthetic data, not validated on real children. Stateless. Sits behind the gateway: every route except /health needs X-Gateway-Key.
info.title: Thanzi screening engine API

get.description: No credential needed and nothing else returned, so a container health check works.
What is running: versions and state of the engine, the ML models, growth monitoring and the optional LLM service.
Request counts by route and status, and /v1/screen latency. Counts and durations only, in memory (D176).

post.description: Screen one child. Worker view never contains HIV information. Audit view needs X-Audit-Key.

200.description: Worker view by default. view=audit returns the audit view. A baby routed to the preterm engine gets the preterm response (route=preterm).

post.description:
Flag districts with higher SAM+MAM prevalence among screened children. Takes counts already grouped by the
caller (no child records, no fine geography). Advisory only: never changes an individual classification.
